method.windows: Half-open sim_time_seconds; post-step states labelled with zero-based evaluator step time. Displacements use last-minus-first sample within the named window.
method.tracking: body linear and angular velocities against recorded commands
method.heading: unwrapped yaw from wxyz world quaternion
method.comparison: Matching scenario contracts, seed42, one environment, 1000 policy steps (20s); pushes off, other training randomization and observation noise retained. Different checkpoints and effective training configurations; not a single-parameter causal experiment.

limitations: One seed and one final checkpoint per run; not a checkpoint-selection study.
No new JIT/ONNX/MuJoCo or hardware validation.
Foot contact and discriminator per-step signals absent from these evaluation telemetries; do not infer mechanism.
